## 📋 Pull Request Description

**What does this PR do?**

A clear and concise description of what this pull request accomplishes.

## 🔗 Related Issue

**Fixes/Closes/Addresses:** # (issue number)

If there's no related issue, please explain why this change is needed.

## 🎯 Type of Change

What type of change does this PR introduce?

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style/UI change (formatting, renaming, etc.)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 Test addition or improvement
- [ ] 🔧 Chore (dependency updates, tooling, etc.)

## 🧪 Testing

**How has this been tested?**

- [ ] Local development server (frontend + backend)
- [ ] Production build (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Manual testing in multiple browsers
- [ ] Mobile/responsive testing
- [ ] API testing (if backend changes)
- [ ] Error handling testing
- [ ] Accessibility testing

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS Ventura]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 119, Firefox 118]
- Node.js: [e.g. 18.17.0]
- Python: [e.g. 3.11.5]

## 📋 Checklist

**Before submitting this PR, please ensure:**

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] Self-review of code has been performed
- [ ] Code is commented, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] No console.log or debugging code left in
- [ ] Code is formatted properly (Prettier/ESLint)

### Testing
- [ ] Changes have been tested locally
- [ ] Frontend builds successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Backend starts without errors
- [ ] All features work as expected
- [ ] No new warnings or errors in console

### Documentation
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if needed)
- [ ] Comments have been added for complex logic
- [ ] API documentation updated (if backend changes)
- [ ] README updated (if needed)

### Git
- [ ] Commits follow conventional commit format
- [ ] Branch is up to date with main
- [ ] No merge conflicts
- [ ] Commit messages are clear and descriptive

### Review Ready
- [ ] PR title is clear and descriptive
- [ ] PR description explains what and why
- [ ] Screenshots/demos included for UI changes
- [ ] Ready for code review
